text:
brynn: Heads up — noticed two DX rough edges in the new Next + LangChain starter and the eval-harness sample: (1) SSR occasionally 401s in local dev due to ephemeral cookie timing, (2) streaming agent examples don't cancel on client disconnect in serverless. Want to consolidate fixes into one small example PR and add an eval that exercises both.

karl: Good find. Which repo path? examples/next-langchain-starter and examples/eval-harness?

brynn: Yup. Repro is simple: run dev proxy + next dev. On cold page loads getServerSideProps -> /api/run returns 401 ~1/12. Also if you open /api/stream and then navigate away, lambda hangs until timeout.

amira: Two distinct root causes: cookie propagation race for SSR; missing AbortSignal support or handler wiring for stream cancellation. We should do small, contained changes in the examples so users see best-practices without waiting for SDK changes.

eve: Proposal: (A) add a tiny dev-only token-read helper that retries token extraction twice with short jitter (30-120ms) and logs debug hint. (B) update stream example to use AbortController wiring: req.on('close', () => ac.abort()). (C) add an eval in examples/eval-harness that mocks both flaky states deterministically.

sam: For (C) keep tests deterministic — don't rely on timing. Use a cookie-store mock that returns undefined on first call then token on second call to simulate propagation. For stream, mock the iterator so calling emitter.emit('close') triggers iterator.return and assert handler exits.

karl: Sounds good. A few implementation notes: keep the retry behind NODE_ENV !== 'production' and mark logs as debug. For the AbortController pattern, include a short comment about edge runtimes where req.on('close') may differ.

amira: I'll draft the helper snippet for the README and a tiny helper file examples/shared/dev-token-helper.js: it will be tiny and only used by examples for dev DX. Add a short Troubleshooting bullet in the starter README: "SSR 401 during local dev -> clear cookies, restart proxy, or use server-token-exchange".

brynn: Also add an eval-harness test that runs `node -e` style unit test: require the handler, inject mocked req/res, simulate missing cookie then present cookie, assert final response is 200. Keep it fast.

sam: PR checklist: updated README, dev-token-helper, stream AbortController example, mock-based tests in eval-harness, and a link in devex docs to streaming best-practices. I'll open the PR and mark flaky-timing tests as mock-only.

patch-bot: Note: examples CI will run. If any test uses real network or waits, CI will fail. Use jest mocks/time-mocks.

karl: One more ask: include a snippet showing the recommended server-side token exchange (server calls auth proxy to mint token) vs calling a browser-only endpoint. Many folks copy browser flows into SSR and hit this.

eve: Good call. Add a short `server-exchange.md` in examples/docs that shows code for server-side exchange and mentions App Router differences.

amira: I'll open the PR and tag brynn/sam for review. After merge we can add a short changelog entry in devex: "Examples: SSR auth retry + stream cancel pattern".

brynn: Thanks all — this should reduce onboarding tickets and make the eval-harness better for CI checks. :rocket:
